out_of_scope: encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com and other Google static hosts

allowed: Port and service scanning against the origin IP
Web application vulnerability testing (OWASP Top 10 + auth flows, IDOR, SSRF, file uploads, template injection, deserialisation, business logic)
Directory / content discovery with rate limits
Manual PoC exploitation limited to minimum evidence
prohibited: Password brute force / credential stuffing / spraying
Destructive commands (data deletion, ransomware simulation, malware)
Use of any discovered credentials to interact with third-party services (e.g., AWS APIs)
Testing of any asset in the out_of_scope list
